attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3071/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's fourteen Agapius folders is this man: they are kept on other days and none is set in Cappadocia. The display name takes the day. The Cappadocian origin is the page's own, on the authority it cites: «Στον Παρισινό Κώδικα 1578 σημειώνεται, ότι ήταν από την Καππαδοκία». The page gives no year and no emperor, so no `dates` object is proposed, and no `locations`, because a province is all it names. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
